newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Plunges as buy support crumbles.
newsitem.headline: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Plunges as buy support crumbles.

text.p: The much anticipated plunge in Singapore gas oil prices finally came true as five sellers emerged with offers below the $24.00 support and with one offer even testing $23.00 a barrel, traders said on Monday.
No bids were seen in the market, traders said.

Traders have been talking about the weak regional fundamenatals on gas oil since March, especially as China was not taking as many Singapore cargoes, while most of what they have been buying has been from South Korea.

But the market has been persistently supported by a group of three traders who have purchased about 22 million barrels since March 3, but their purchases have slowed to one and two cargoes per day since May.
The three traders have bought at an average of $25.00-$26.00 per barrel since March with the lowest seen on Thursday at $24.30.
But the buyers failed to appear on Friday and were not in sight on Monday as traders believe that they have finally ceased supporting the gas oil market.
But traders noted that one of the buyers on Thursday and Friday bought a total of two million barrels of swaps gas oil.
Swaps for July traded at $23.10 on Monday, down steeply from Friday's average of $24.55.
A physical offers for June 24-28 lifting was seen at $23.00, free-on-board basis, while early July was offered at $23.50 and $23.80. But nothing was traded.
Traders said Chinese ports remained congested with at least three ships awaiting to discharge off the southern port of Xiamen.
Prices to China have also plunged with a Swiss trader heard selling to a Chinese buyer at $182 per tonne, cost-and-freight southern China, from more than $190 over a month ago.
Prices to Hong Kong has slipped below a 70-cent-per-barrel premium, c-and-f, from over $1.00 premiums more than a month ago.
Jet fuel values also suffered a battering. Three offers were seen with end-June seen as low as $23.25, while an early July cargo was offered at $23.75.
